stories.title: Define provider score schema and contract
stories.description: Create Pydantic models defining input measures (≥3 required), weight configuration, and output composite score structure. Ensure compatibility with existing provider detail data structures and enforce deterministic inputs.

stories.title: Implement deterministic scoring algorithm
stories.description: Build core scoring logic that aggregates ≥3 provider quality measures using fixed weights. Ensure no randomness, consistent normalization, and deterministic output for identical inputs.

stories.title: Integrate scoring into EvaluateCare facade
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to call the scoring engine and return composite provider score alongside existing provider detail responses.

stories.title: Expose scoring via API response contract
stories.description: Update FastAPI response models and tool outputs to include provider composite score and component measures so frontend/chat can consume results.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py (FastAPI adapter and response handling); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_router.py (tool output handling)

stories.title: Unit tests for scoring engine
stories.description: Create unit tests validating deterministic behavior, correct weighting, minimum measure enforcement (≥3), and edge cases (missing/null inputs).

stories.title: Integration tests for facade scoring flow
stories.description: Validate end-to-end flow from EvaluateCare facade through scoring engine to API response, ensuring score appears correctly in provider evaluation outputs.
